newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines names new president.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines names new president.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc. on Thursday said Bruce Nobles, its president and chief executive, had resigned.

The company said Paul Casey was appointed to succeed Nobles. Most recently, Casey was president and chief executive of the Hawaii Visitors and Convention Bureau. He is a career airline executive based in Hawaii, it said.

"With Hawaiian back on solid financial footing, I am satisfied that we have accomplished all we set out to do when I joined the company in 1993," Nobles said in a statement. "After an extensive search, (Chairman) John Adams and I believe that Paul Casey is the right individual to lead this company into the next century."
